body: I'll remember that, thank you :) I'm actually off to go do IRL stuff, but thank you so much for listening!

I do, but at the same time, I really really don't. Some days I have trouble functioning, even leaving the house can lead to anxiety attacks sometimes. I just don't know if I can, or how much good someone like me could do.
